articles.title: Magdalena Andersson once again given job of building new Swedish government
articles.summary: The speaker of Sweden's parliament has once again given Social Democrat leader Magdalena Andersson the task of finding support among the other political parties before her candidacy for prime minister is put to parliament for a vote.

articles.title: Sweden holds new round of talks to form a government
articles.summary: Sweden's parliament speaker held talks with party leaders on Wednesday to determine who should try next to form a government after the country's September 13th election.

articles.title: Sweden Democrat leader calls for vote on Andersson as PM

articles.title: Sweden's Green Party calls for immediate stop to teen deportations
articles.summary: Sweden's Green Party have tabled a motion in parliament calling for an immediate and permanent stop to teen deportations, arguing that those affected do not have time to wait for government talks to be completed.

articles.title: Speaker of the Riksdag calls new talks as Swedish government deadlock continues

articles.title: Strategy or spite? Why is Magda giving up on forming Sweden's next government?

articles.title: Social Democrat Magdalena Andersson abandons attempt to form a government

articles.title: Where are the breakthroughs for the radical and far-right in Europe?

articles.title: OPINION: It's not just immigrants – Swedes are clan voters too

articles.title: Don't 'vote red': Facebook 'votes wanted' post reported to Swedish election agency

articles.title: OPINION: Sweden's election won't erase what the last four years did to immigrants

articles.title: 'Sweden has fulfilled its commitments': Migration minister defends Brexit deportations

The West Coast and nearby towns provide plenty of opportunities for a memorable day trip from Sweden's second city: here are five of our favourite destinations complete with insider tips.
